name: Instagram Iris
tagline: Scores IG creators against your ICP and drafts the first DM
description: Give it your ideal-customer profile and it scores Instagram creators against that bar, so your outreach list starts qualified instead of guessed. For each one it hands you a hook drawn from that creator's own recent feed plus a ready-to-edit DM you send yourself.
author: FrankFindsOut
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
